params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"
Push-Location $wt
try {
  Write-Output "HEAD_BEFORE=$((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim())"
  Write-Output "GIT_DIR=$((git rev-parse --git-dir).Trim())"
  $lock=(git rev-parse --git-path index.lock).Trim()
  Write-Output "INDEX_LOCK=$lock EXISTS=$(Test-Path $lock)"
  Write-Output 'STATUS_BEFORE_BEGIN'; git status --short --branch; Write-Output 'STATUS_BEFORE_END'
  Write-Output "README_FIRST=$(Get-Content README.md -TotalCount 1)"
  $py=@'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("README.md")
s=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
if not s.startswith("# v8.8.5 Universal Mod Manager"):
    if not s.startswith("# v8.8.4 Universal Mod Manager"):
        raise SystemExit("unexpected README title")
    s=s.replace("# v8.8.4 Universal Mod Manager", "# v8.8.5 Universal Mod Manager", 1)
    marker="## v8.8.4 — support recovery hardening"
    section="""## v8.8.5 — persisted game-profile ID containment

- Persisted and upserted game-profile IDs must now be exact canonical single-segment storage identifiers; traversal, separators, uppercase/noncanonical spellings, and other hostile IDs are rejected before they gain filesystem authority.
- Generic-game workspace and per-game state paths are normalized and checked for containment under manager-owned roots before directories are created.
- Rejected persisted profiles are ignored without rewriting hostile registry input, and regressions cover traversal/separator/casing attacks plus escaped-workspace sentinels.

"""
    if marker not in s:
        raise SystemExit("README v8.8.4 marker missing")
    s=s.replace(marker,section+marker,1)
    old="Duplicate cleanup crash-durable reconciliation, broader diagnostic export sanitization, remaining crash-bisector evidence risks, game-profile ID repair, and launch-observation transaction repair remain explicit follow-ups."
    new="Duplicate cleanup crash-durable reconciliation, broader diagnostic export sanitization, remaining crash-bisector evidence risks, and launch-observation transaction repair remain explicit follow-ups. Persisted game-profile ID repair is closed by v8.8.5."
    if old not in s:
        raise SystemExit("README follow-up sentence missing")
    s=s.replace(old,new,1)
    p.write_text(s,encoding="utf-8")
'@
  $py | python -
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'README patch failed' }
  git diff --check
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'diff check failed' }
  if((git status --porcelain -- README.md).Length -gt 0){
    git add README.md
    git commit -m "Document v8.8.5 profile ID containment"
    if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'README commit failed' }
  }
  Write-Output "HEAD_AFTER=$((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim())"
  Write-Output 'STATUS_AFTER_BEGIN'; git status --short --branch; Write-Output 'STATUS_AFTER_END'
} finally { Pop-Location }
